name: agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene
body: The distributed `agent-builder` owns repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene. It holds a main-write grant on `AGENTS.md`, audits the guide, and removes any change-set-flow content found there, because the change-set flow is owned solely by the distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt. The `agent-builder` preserves all repo-specific content, edits an `AGENTS.md` that is present, and adds neither a flow summary nor a pointer to the navigator. The rule applies in every apg project. Main-write paths across the two carve-outs are `.opencode/agents/**`, the `opencode.json` agent-model map, the repo-root `AGENTS.md`, and the release-agent artefact set; carve-out 1 covers the first three and the carve-out count is two. The code surface is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`.
